programs.title: Naked and Afraid 5
programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.The operators show how daredevils, relying on their own company, learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska meets Nokur from the Toposa tribe.The woman collects gold every day, but lives in extreme poverty.He lives in South Sudan, in a mud hut covered with dried grass.The heroine of the episode is the mother of three children and the third wife of the man with whom she shares her life.In the past, her tribe was engaged in cattle grazing, gathering and farming.Because selling gold can bring in more money, today women, children and men can be found on the rivers in this region looking for the precious metal.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: For the fifth time, Martyna Wojciechowska sets off on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.

programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programs.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.
